caption: The drawing depicts a wooden stand composed of a round tabletop supported by a vertically oriented, spiral-carved central pole. At the top of the pole, there is a horizontal arm that holds two candle holders, each holding a white candle with a dark base. The stand sits on three outwardly splayed legs connected to the central pole via a cylindrical base. The wood is depicted in various shades of brown, with the spiral carving and legs slightly darker than the tabletop and arm. In the lower left corner, there is a small, inset schematic drawing that provides measurements: 35 inches in height and 14 inches in diameter for the tabletop. The image is bordered by a thin, single-line frame, with the bottom right corner containing a handwritten signature and a number. The background is a plain off-white or light beige color with no additional elements.
title: Maple Candlestand
